name: agent-viewer
description: View running and past Claude Code agents on this machine

agentViewer.runningWindowMinutes.description: A session is shown as 'running' for this many minutes after its last file write. Reduce if you want short-burst sessions to flip to idle sooner.

agentViewer.doneAgeHours.description: Sessions with no activity for this many hours are archived. Lower values reduce memory usage; increase if you want older sessions visible without a manual refresh.

agentViewer.reconcileIntervalSeconds.description: How often the watcher reconciler runs. It adds file watchers for newly-active session directories and removes watchers for inactive ones. Lower values catch state transitions faster; higher values reduce CPU.

agentViewer.activeStatScanIntervalSecond.description: How often known sessions are stat'd to detect resumed-from-done activity. Catches sessions written to without a corresponding chokidar event. Higher values reduce CPU at the cost of slower detection of resumed sessions.
